summary: P0 escalation approval responsiveness: isolate synchronous decision I/O from the ASGI loop, reduce duplicate verified ledger reads, bound browser requests and reconcile unknown outcomes without automatic resubmission, and prevent identity-mismatched probes from publishing managed runtime manifests. No authorization or decision semantics are relaxed. Independent review, full R9, remote CI and production acceptance are pending until separately evidenced.

evidence: Targeted backend regression: human authentication, command SHA binding, one-time token, duplicate decision rejection, slow approval concurrent with eight read-only HTTP requests, and one verified ledger snapshot per list response.

components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: If any decision or authentication regression is found, stop delivery and correct or revert the candidate; do not bypass the existing approval gate.
components.rollback_route: Revert the isolated candidate; no ledger schema migration.
